Effects on the cerebrovascular system. Adverse cerebrov- ascular effects have been reported after the use of subcutaneous sumatriptan including hemiparesis,1 stroke,2,3 and intracerebral haemorrhage.4 Cerebral vasospasm has also been reported5 with the use of oral sumatriptan. However, a study6 of over 63 500 migraine patients in the UK General Practice Research Database failed to find an increased risk of stroke in those patients treated with serotonin agonists. 1.
